PLC Singapore · AI says:

Totally get it—pet shopping can feel like walking into a giant candy store. Here are a few easy ways we can help you narrow things down:

Browse by type/category:
For brands our customers love, check our brand list page for popular options.
For Rogz accessories, you can explore their range of collars, leashes and more, all in various colors.
For cat owners, we carry different types of cat litter plus matching litter boxes and accessories so you can mix and match what suits your cat’s habits.
Shopping channels:
You can shop our full range on our main website.
A selected range is also available via FairPrice Online/FairPrice Group app (note: only some products there, and VIP perks don’t apply on FairPrice).
In‑store options:
Our Pet Lovers Centre Express outlets stock key brands like 1st Choice, Burp, Fish4Dogs/Fish4Cats, Trustie and more, but not always the full range.
If you’re interested in hamsters as pets, we do have different hamster types available and share care notes like cage size and social behavior.

If you tell us your pet type (cat, dog, small animal, etc.), their age, and what you’re looking for (food, litter, accessories, a new pet), we can point you to the most suitable categories and brands from these ranges.
